# Switch NX2 - read when the Eglantine GUI starts.
# One NAME=VALUE per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A variable already set in the environment wins over this file.
# Between files, the user copy (%APPDATA%\eglantine\nx2_switches.txt, or
# $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/eglantine/nx2_switches.txt; in a portable build user\nx2_switches.txt, or
# user/config/nx2_switches.txt) wins over this one, so editing this file is never
# needed: copy the lines you want into your own and restart.
#
# Restart the emulator after editing.

# --- Performance tuning defaults for Switch 2 ---
# Offload GPU method/macro execution to the back thread (SPLIT=2 delivers up to +54% FPS alone).
EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=2

# Batch GPU fence syncpoints to reduce host driver overhead and smooth frametimes.
EDEN_NX2_FENCE_BATCH=1

# Leave buffer downloads disabled on Switch 2 (default): forcing downloads (=1) copies back
# 90-220 MB/s of buffers CPU never touches, causing heavy mutex contention and dropping FPS by ~38-63%.
#EDEN_NX2_BUFFER_DOWNLOADS=1

# Paces frame submission 2 frames ahead. Reduces frametime spikes, but adds ~1-2 frames of input latency.
# Enable only if frame pacing stability is preferred over responsive controls.
#EDEN_NX2_FRAMES_AHEAD=2

# Opt-in (default off): the host timer thread, which delivers the guest's timed events (vsync among
# them), waits on a high resolution waitable timer instead of a condition variable wait that follows
# the Windows timer resolution. Windows 10 1803 or later. Read at start; =1 turns it on.
#EDEN_NX2_HIRES_TIMER=1

# Opt-in (default off): the GPU ASTC to BC transcode records the decode and the encode in one host
# GPU submit instead of submitting after the decode. Only has an effect where ASTC textures are
# transcoded on the GPU (hosts without ASTC support). Read once; =1 turns it on.
#EDEN_NX2_ASTC_ONE_SUBMIT=1

# --- Workarounds / Debug ---
# Terrain/indirect drawing fix for Donkey Kong Bananza: enabled by default. Set to 0 only to leave to GPU.
#EDEN_NX2_RESETFIX=0

# Drop reactive-flushing read traps on Switch 2 programs (opt-in; can reduce FPS from 29 to 24 in MKW).
#EDEN_NX2_NO_REACTIVE=1

#EDEN_NX2_MME_JIT=0
#EDEN_NX2_PBFLUSH=0
#EDEN_NX2_SKIP_SAME=0
#EDEN_NX2_INLINE_DEFER=0
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT_SKIP=1
#EDEN_NX2_AUTO_STUB=1
#EDEN_NX2_KEEP_ASTC=1

# --- Test switches (for unattended-run tests; never set these in normal use) ---
# Crash the emulator on purpose after N presented frames (a null write on the thread that presents).
# Used to test that a crash during a scripted run (eden-cli --report ...) leaves a report with
# exit.reason "host_crash" and the process exit code 73. Off unless set.
#EDEN_NX2_TEST_CRASH_AFTER_FRAMES=300
# --- Speed experiments (off by default; each is measured on and off before it is recommended) ---
# Pin the GPU threads to their own physical performance cores and keep the emulated CPU cores off
# them (Windows only; ignored on CPUs with fewer than 6 physical performance cores, or with
# EDEN_HYBRID_CORES=0). Can hurt performance on CPUs with few cores. Set to 1 to turn on.
#EDEN_NX2_PIN_GPU_THREADS=1

# Skip the Vulkan queue submit a fence flush makes when nothing was recorded since the last submit
# (fewer submits per second; compare "submits by origin: fence" in the EDEN_NX2_GPU_PROFILE log
# line, written every 10 seconds). Set to 1 to turn on.
#EDEN_NX2_SKIP_EMPTY_FLUSH=1
# --- Speed experiments (off by default; each is measured on and off before it is recommended) ---
# Keep the GPU front/back thread split running at GPU accuracy High (and safe DMA). Today the split
# only runs below High. With this on, the back writes out what the texture and query caches hold
# of a command list before the front reads it, and the macros stay on the back at High. Weaker
# than a plain High: command lists a draw writes into a buffer are not flushed before they are
# read. Watch the sky and other buffer-fed effects, especially in long sessions. Compare fps and
# the "gwait" and "idle" columns of the 10 second EDEN_NX2_GPU_PROFILE line ("safe read" under
# its drain sites). Set to 1 to turn on.
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT_AT_HIGH=1
